description: An example registry extension: one small, ungated checkpoint a CPU can run end to end. Name this file in ANAMNESIS_MODELS to add the row. The architecture fields are the checkpoint's own config.json; the layer plan scales the 8b row's depths to 24 layers; temperature and top_p are the checkpoint's generation_config.json.

qwen2.5-0.5b.name: qwen2.5-0.5b
qwen2.5-0.5b.notes: A dense decoder, so the hook path runs it and the fast lane, which reads dense Llama only, does not. The checkpoint's own sampler also applies a repetition penalty of 1.1 and top-k 20, which a registry row does not carry; a pass here samples without them.
